body:
This is probably not a bug. You're adding the singleton dynamically:

```gdscript
add_autoload_singleton("Singleton", "res://addons/mainscreenplugin/singleton.gd")
```

`main_screen.gd` is loaded as a dependency on `mainscreenplugin.gd` (via `main_screen.tscn`), but at this point the global identifier `Singleton` has not yet been added. If you restart the editor after activating the plugin, the error disappears. If you want to avoid the error upon initial activation, you should avoid directly or indirectly preloading scripts that depend on `Singleton` in `mainscreenplugin.gd` (however, this is still not a guarantee; a script with a non-existent singleton may be opened manually in the editor or automatically by a file system scan).

Regarding the `Opcode: 115 (please report)` error, it is caused by incorrect use of the `GD_ERR_BREAK` macro in the VM. We should set `err_text` in cases where a function's fail exit might not be caused by a compiler/codegen bug, but by some relatively normal situation. This avoids falsely encouraging users to report "bugs".

We rarely use this GitHub feature, usually only for high-priority issues (regressions, release blockers) assigned to maintainers. You can take on any task as long as you're confident it's valid and understand how to solve it. If you're unsure, it's best to take on tasks marked as "Up for grabs" in triage projects and check the issue discussion. If you want to know if anyone else is working on this task, you can ask in the comments or in the corresponding [Contributors Chat](https://chat.godotengine.org/) channel.

It might be better to leave this in `_{enable,disable}_plugin()` to avoid unnecessary changes to `project.godot`, which could create unnecessary diffs in VCS (git). You just need to ensure the code is executed at the right time and replace `preload()` with `load()`.

Nah. Inserting `await get_tree().process_frame` solved the issue. Maybe this case should be documented?

```
[...]
      if nodebank_editor_plugin:                                                                        
          unregister_maszyna_editor_plugin(nodebank_editor_plugin)

      remove_custom_type("MaszynaEnvironmentNode") 
```
